about_short_description.short_description: Aquarium is expertise in making machine learning accessible to its customers that helps to simplify their models by improving datasets.

product.name: Data Quality Analysis
product.description: A tool that helps identify and fix data quality issues by visualizing data and labels, finding errors, and collaborating on dataset problems.

product.name: Model Evaluation
product.description: A service to analyze model performance by comparing model inferences with human labels, diagnosing failures, and tracking improvements over time.

product.name: Data Collection & Sampling
product.description: A system to efficiently collect and sample data by searching large unlabeled datasets to find and label the most useful examples for model improvement.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: A set of APIs and webhooks that connect Aquarium with existing ML pipelines and labeling systems to automate data workflows and enable seamless collaboration.
